subject: general
question: Which Five-Year Plan’s realised growth rate was more than the target growth rate?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**First Five Year Plan:**

 
• The First Five Year Plan in India was active between 1951 and 1956 with the target growth rate of **2.1% of annual gross domestic product (GDP) growth.**
 
• The plan was based on the** Harrod-Domar model.**
 
• This plan gave priority to the agricultural sector of the country.
 
• The First Five Year Plan was presented before the parliament by **Jawaharlal Nehru.**
 
• **Gulzarilal Nanda **was the vice-president of the First Five Year Plan.
 
• **Economist K N Raj **is known as the architect of this plan.
 
• It was** quasi-successful** for the government.
